title: Embeddings + Rerank interactive walkthrough assets and WCAG-accessible screenshots
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a set of interactive walkthrough visuals and accessibility-compliant screenshots for the Embeddings + Rerank quickstart. Deliverables include: a step-by-step pipeline diagram optimized for documentation and slide decks, three annotated sample output screenshots (default, 'edge-case low-relevance', and 'rerank-improved'), an interactive component mock (Figma prototype) showing input -> vectorize -> retrieve -> rerank -> output, and video-friendly motion specs for team docs. The goal is to improve first-time user success, reduce support tickets for embeddings onboarding, and provide assets for the docs quickstart, product tour, and marketing hero cards.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline diagram in SVG + PNG sizes (1200x600, 800x400) with editable layers in Figma
Three annotated screenshots exported at 2x for retina, with accessible alt text and contrast checks passed
Interactive Figma prototype with hotspots for 5 steps and tooltip content, linked from docs
Motion spec (.json Lottie or CSS keyframes) for 6-8s walkthrough clip for product tour
Design tokens and color variants for light/dark themes and high-contrast accessibility
Screenshot copy and labels localized-ready (English + placeholders for i18n)
assets: figma: Embeddings Quickstart - Interactive Walkthrough (file v3)
tasks: Sketch updated pipeline with emphasis on caching and rerank step
Produce annotated screenshot variants and run contrast checks
Build Figma interactive prototype and share for PM/Eng review
Create motion spec and export Lottie; verify playhead timings
Prepare alt text and content labels for docs engineers
Package assets in Drive and update docs quickstart page with links
design_notes: Avoid using model names in visuals; use generic icons and labels (Embed -> Index -> Retrieve -> Rerank)
Show cost/latency callouts in optional overlay rather than primary art
Use rounded card styles consistent with Console design system and 8px grid
Annotate fallback behavior: show a small dashed path for fallback to 'catalog-compact' model
Create a separate high-contrast variant for legal/regulatory screenshots
